propositions: The store-wide compaction sweep performs one full-history git walk per ticket inside the store write lock, holding it for minutes and blocking all writers fleet-wide.

Per-ticket history walks in the ledger builder fall through to per-event wildcard walks on cache misses, with leading-wildcard pathspecs defeating pruning, amplifying the lock hold cost beyond one-per-ticket.
The _commit_backfill staging uses unscoped `git add -A`, allowing concurrent writers' in-flight event files to be committed under the compaction message.
The sweep never re-yields mid-run; it probes write_lock_is_busy once before starting but never again in the per-ticket loop, so writers arriving after the sweep starts wait for the full run.
A prebuilt position-keyed commit map (build_position_commit_map) can be built once per sweep before any lock and consulted per-ticket, replacing N walks with one.
The fix must preserve the fsck rebuild path (compact_rebuild.py) and six existing test call sites by making the map parameter optional with a None default.
